name: Voalack
summary: Design agreed. Original prototype baseline reproduced. Durable implementation and live qualification remain open.
license_status: No Voalack project licence is published in the inspected repository.

updates.label: Prototype baseline
updates.title: 32 tests, with a stricter baseline runner.
updates.text: The original ACK MVP was rebuilt and tested as an installed wheel. The corrected runner also demonstrated that failed tests, a changed wheel member and a missing entry point each return failure. Durable-runtime and live-system qualification remain ahead.

updates.label: Design agreement
updates.title: A durable handoff, specified.
updates.text: The design and its transaction, capture and audit amendments are published on main. Implementation can proceed, with real Alerta and PostgreSQL qualification still required.
